name: 4lwayz
text:
**Experienced devs wanted: let's help DexNom make a real build.**

While most builds chase FPS, DexNom is going after the hard part: native resolution, full ray tracing (already working, about 1 fps for now) and memory use that fits normal PCs.

He needs people who know GPU memory, CPU-GPU transfers, texture streaming, D3D12 or Rust. Testers and profilers are welcome too. DM him:
https://x.com/DexNom_/status/2125947738420551767
https://redd.it/1y628de
